# GitHub Branch

Creates a Plane-compatible git branch for a story. Branch name includes the Plane ticket ID (e.g. `feature/NOKEY-42-story-slug`) for automatic work item linking.

## Usage

Load the bellosoft-github skill, then run GITHUB_BRANCH for the target story.
